flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/{hook/useODH (Override modal, onOverrideOk), form/HirerForm, form/DriverForm, context/NoticeContext}, utils/mapping/Notice/NoticeOld. ocmsadminapi ManualFurnishController GET .../check-existing + ExistingParticularsResponse exist but the UI does not use them
note: The overwrite prompt exists and names the role and notice number. The existing particulars (name, ID, address) are visible in the form on the same tab before the officer presses Furnish, but are not shown inside the prompt dialog; after the officer answers Yes, all fields of that role are cleared (except ID type and mobile code) to be re-entered. The backend ExistingParticularsResponse (list of ID, name, address, contact) is built only by the check-existing endpoint that no UI calls; its address is also always null because the 'registered_mail' filter does not match the type_of_address values. The prompt and display fits are kept the same as story 41.44.
recommendation: Claim partially. The overwrite prompt exists; the old particulars are shown in the form but not inside the prompt.

steps.step: OCMS prompts that the existing particulars will be overwritten
steps.detail: The Override ModalConfirm titled 'Furnish {role}' carries 'Existing {role} details will be overwritten. Do you want to proceed to furnish for notice no. ...?' with Yes/No buttons (useODH.tsx:533-545), opened when existing is present (useODH.tsx:143-148). Same as the prompt step in 41.44.

steps.step: The existing particulars (ID number, name, address) are shown in the relevant fields
steps.detail: The name, ID type/number and address fields are filled from stored data on the Owner/Hirer/Driver tab (NoticeOld.ts:392-394; HirerForm.tsx:288-330, 160-216) before the dialog; the dialog does not contain them. Same as the display step in 41.44.

steps.step: After the officer agrees, the fields are cleared to take the new particulars
steps.detail: onOverrideOk closes the dialog, clears all fields of that role except ID type and mobile code, then setEditMode(true) and setActiveMode('CREATE') (useODH.tsx:224-240); onOverrideClose only closes the dialog without changing data (useODH.tsx:241-243).
